deadlines.label: Rolling; applications accepted and reviewed while funds remain
deadlines.quote: Applications will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis.

sections.name: Description of the proposal or project
sections.quote: The application form requests: - A description of the proposal or project;

sections.name: Fit with any applicable transition plan
sections.quote: How the proposal or project fits within any applicable transition plan; and

sections.name: Anticipated impacts (jobs created, property tax generated, economic development benefits, other impacts)
sections.quote: Information on the anticipated impacts of the proposal or project, including jobs created, property tax generated, economic development-related benefits, and any other impacts to the general welfare of the community.

criteria.name: Pre-application meeting with OJT and OEDIT staff
criteria.quote: Request a meeting with OJT and OEDIT staff prior to applying.

criteria.name: Tier One: support from 60 percent or more of the designated jurisdictions
criteria.quote: Secure support for your request from 60 percent or more of the “designated jurisdictions” in the transition community your project is intended to serve

other: Apply through the online funding request form, answering all questions and uploading any additional information requested
format.quote: Answer all questions completely, and upload any additional information requested. Do not submit incomplete applications.

eligibility.item: Only Coal Transition Communities and eligible entities may receive funding; grants are for community entities, not individuals
eligibility.quote: By law, only Coal Transition Communities and “eligible entities” may receive this funding.

eligibility.item: Eligible entities: economic development districts; counties, municipalities and other political subdivisions (including public K-12 schools and special districts); Indian tribes; registered apprenticeship programs; institutions of higher education; public or private nonprofits
eligibility.quote: Economic development districts - Counties, municipalities, or other political subdivisions of the State (including public K12 schools and special districts) - Indian tribes - Registered apprenticeship programs - Institutions of higher education - Public or private nonprofit organizations or associations.

eligibility.item: An eligible entity must be physically located in or serve one or more Tier One or Tier Two coal transition communities
eligibility.quote: To be eligible to apply for and receive funding, an “eligible entity” must either be physically located in or serve one or more Tier One or Tier Two coal transition communities.

eligibility.item: Tier One applications must show support from at least 60 percent of the community's designated jurisdictions (Pueblo: both Pueblo County and the City of Pueblo); not required for Tier Two
eligibility.quote: Regardless of who applies, applications for projects in a Tier One community must show support from at least 60 percent of the “designated jurisdictions” in that community.

eligibility.item: Applications that have not completed the pre-application meeting and jurisdiction support steps are not considered
eligibility.quote: OJT and OEDIT will not consider applications that have not completed these first two steps.

eligibility.item: Yampa Valley and Morgan County funds are fully awarded; limited funding remains for Pueblo County, the West End of Montrose County and Tier II entities
eligibility.quote: At this time, limited funding remains available for Pueblo County, the West End of Montrose County, and eligible Tier II entities. All Yampa Valley and Morgan County funding has been awarded.

eligibility.item: Grants may not pay lost property taxes or fund activities previously supported by lost property taxes
eligibility.quote: Pay lost property taxes or directly fund activities that were previously supported by lost property taxes.

eligibility.item: Grants may not support activities not expected to create jobs paying at or above the community median income, new property tax, or economic diversity
eligibility.quote: Support activities that are not directly or indirectly expected or intended to create jobs that provide incomes at or above the median income of the community

requiredDocuments.quote: Apply for funding by going to and filling out the appropriate application form: Funding request form

requiredDocuments.item: Budget and deliverables for the proposal or project
requiredDocuments.quote: A budget and deliverables for the proposal or project;
